name: Yisong Yue
title: Professor
fitReason: CLF-RL embeds control-Lyapunov-inspired reward shaping into humanoid reinforcement learning. A separate 2025 study develops non-episodic online policy optimization for controllers adapting continuously to disturbance changes.

physicalEvidence.summary: CLF-RL’s December 2025 primary revision deploys three policies on a real Unitree G1, including loaded-backpack tests and a continuous quarter-mile outdoor walk. The online-policy study runs adaptive tuning onboard a physical Crazyflie 2.0 at 500 Hz and also evaluates a 1:6-scale Ackermann car.
